title: TMT-VR: an immersive virtual-reality Trail Making Test (Unity project, head and controller versions, English and Greek)
description:
Unity project for TMT-VR, a virtual-reality version of the Trail Making Test (Parts A and B) for the HTC VIVE Focus Vision. Release 1.1.0 contains four apps: head-direction and controller-ray pointing, each in English and Greek. Each app is built as an Android APK for the standalone headset and as a Windows 64-bit PC VR build; all eight are attached to the GitHub release. The controller apps include a passive motion logger that records events and poses only; no adjusted or motor-corrected score is computed. The repository contains no participant data.

Code: MIT. Spoken instructions, on-screen instruction texts and instruction script: CC BY 4.0. Third-party components keep their own licences; logos and the EU emblem are not licensed (see NOTICE.md).
